newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline eases but French strikes brake losses.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline eases but French strikes brake losses.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices eased with crude, but news of one-day strikes set for Tuesday at three French refineries limited losses, traders said.

Unions said they had given notice of strikes on Tuesday at BP Lavera, Total La Mede and Shell's Berre refinery, where workers plan to extend a strike begun on Monday. Shell's Petit Couronne refinery will operate only at the minimum safe rate on Tuesday,officials said.
Eurograde barges sold around $2 lower at $224 and $223 fob ARA and valued around $221 fob ARA in late trade.
